## Purpose

Describe the reusable public value of this change.

## Evidence label

- [ ] Current MVP
- [ ] Prototype
- [ ] Future research
- [ ] Adjacent research
- [ ] Repository control or documentation

## Publication boundary

- [ ] Examples are synthetic.
- [ ] No real employee, candidate, manager, customer, family, or employer-confidential data is included.
- [ ] No private application source, configuration, local path, identifier, or provenance record is included.
- [ ] Sources, uncertainty, and human-review limits are explicit.
- [ ] `python3 scripts/check-publication-boundary.py` passes.
- [ ] Repository structure and local-link checks pass.
